itemdesc-soulgear: Use while aiming at a block to bind your soul. On your next death, your inventory will be preserved. Does not change your spawn point.
message-soul-protection-gained: Your soul has been bound. Your inventory will be preserved on your next death.
message-soul-protection-used: The Soul Gear's protection is saving your inventory...
message-inventory-restored: Your inventory has been restored by the Soul Gear's protection!
